devops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood.company/recordings/1809012345-townhall.mp4

Elaine: TL;DR from today’s all-hands:
- Product health: Q1 MAU +32% q/q; infra cost growth contained. Next quarter focus: reduce EU tail latency.
- EU rollout: Canary scheduled in two weeks to eu-west-1 with a small model subset. Ops will gate on p95 and error rate.
- Security & retention: Default retention for non-enterprise workspaces will move from 90 -> 30 days; customers can opt in for extended retention via a request flow. Security will publish a clear FAQ and migration steps.
- Hiring: Hiring freeze lifted for prioritized infra and product roles; new IC ladder and promotion criteria published.
- Telemetry: New dashboard surfaces per-model p95, request patterns, and budget burn rate; short demo clip uploaded.

Action items:
- Ops: publish EU canary runbook, monitoring dashboard, and alert thresholds before rollout.
- Security: post data-retention FAQ and the opt-in request process.
- People Ops: distribute hiring triage and interview panels list to managers.
- Product: add API compatibility guarantees blurb to the developer portal and customer-facing docs.
